subject: Architecture
title: Hagia Sophia: The Dome That Changed Everything
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Hagia Sophia: The Dome That Changed Everything.

hook.text: Emperor Justinian wanted a building so grand it would make Solomon jealous.

buildup.text: In just five years, 10,000 workers built a dome 180 feet high with no internal supports.

discovery.text: Forty windows ring the dome's base, making it appear to float on a ring of light.

twist.text: The dome collapsed in an earthquake 21 years after completion and had to be rebuilt higher.

climax.text: Hagia Sophia served as a church, a mosque, and a museum — all within the same walls.

punchline.text: One building. Three religions. Fifteen hundred years of awe.

quiz.question: What creates the illusion of the Hagia Sophia dome floating?
options: Mirror tiles reflecting the interior light
Forty windows ringing the dome's base
A thin cable system suspending it from above
